metadata.title: That 1 kill where I definitely wasn’t aiming but the game said ‘sure, take it’
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just score a hit by accident?
Enemy probably took a nap mid-fight.
Click if your aim’s a mess but you still collect kills.
Valorant logic making no sense as always.

Tap if your aim’s a joke but kills still happen!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
